evals.prompt: I just ran the test suite and it generated an HTML coverage report at /home/workspace/project/coverage/index.html — can you show it to the user so they can review it?
evals.expected_output: Should use cloudagent open-file to present the coverage report, not just print the path or tell the user to open it manually.

evals.prompt: Start a dev server for this Next.js app on port 3000 so the user can preview it in their browser
evals.expected_output: Should start the server and use cloudagent http-forwards (not cloudagent ports) to create a public HTTPS URL, then use cloudagent open-url to send it to the user.

evals.prompt: Set up the superpowers visual companion browser tool so I can use it for live UI iteration
evals.expected_output: Should create an HTTP forward for the companion port, patch ws:// to wss:// in the companion HTML, and send the forwarded URL to the user via cloudagent open-url.
